name: FusionAttention

query.description: query tensor for fused attention, dtype float16

key.description: key tensor for fused attention, dtype float16

value.description: value tensor for fused attention, dtype float16

pre_tockens.description: int, number of preceding tokens for causal window, default=2147483647

next_tockens.description: int, number of following tokens for causal window, default=2147483647

inner_precise.description: int, inner computation precision mode, default=0

prefix.description: optional prefix tensor for prefix attention

actual_seq_qlen.description: optional actual sequence lengths for query

actual_seq_kvlen.description: optional actual sequence lengths for key/value

gen_mask_parallel.description: bool, whether to generate mask in parallel, default=True

sync.description: bool, whether to synchronize execution, default=False
